stories.headline: Kyle Larson wins at Talladega for the first time
stories.summary: The YellaWood 500 was run at Talladega Superspeedway in Lincoln, Alabama, on 25 October. Kyle Larson won it, ahead of William Byron and Ricky Stenhouse Jr., and it was his first NASCAR Cup Series win at the circuit. An overtime finish stretched the race from 188 laps to 189.

stories.headline: Serbia's Student List wins the early election
stories.summary: Serbia elected a new National Assembly on 25 October, in an early election; one had originally been due by December 2027. The Student List won 53.3% of the valid votes, with 96.9% of polling stations counted, against 39.7% for the Aleksandar Vučić – United Serbia list. Vučić conceded defeat, ending the Serbian Progressive Party's hold on power since 2012.

stories.headline: Bulgaria's presidential vote goes to a second round
stories.summary: Bulgaria voted for a president on 25 October. The incumbent, Iliana Iotova, took 35% of the vote and the former prime minister Andrey Gyurov 32%, so the two will meet again in a runoff on 1 November. Turnout was a record low.

stories.headline: A giant fungus turns up in China's forests
stories.summary: Scientists surveying forests in Yunnan, in China, have found a giant fungus new to science. Its upright reproductive structures reach 50 cm in height and can weigh as much as 2.2 kg, and the species has been named Dianjunus rex. Its family appears to have originated about 65 million years ago, roughly a million years after the extinction that ended the dinosaurs.
